studies.study_name: Crooke et al. 2017 integrated safety analysis of platelet effects of 2'MOE ASOs in the Ionis integrated 2'MOE safety database (ISDB)
studies.design: Retrospective integrated (pooled) safety analysis of a sponsor-held clinical safety database; includes a subject-level meta-analysis stratified by trial. Not itself a clinical trial.
studies.phase: not_applicable (pools phase 1, phase 2 and phase 3 trials plus open-label extensions)
studies.indication: Mixed: cardiovascular disease (APOB, APOCIII, LPA), diabetes/obesity (PTP1B, GCCR, GCGR, FGFR4, APOCIII), thrombosis (FXI), inflammation/autoimmune (CRP, TNFA), pancreatitis (APOCIII), plus healthy-volunteer phase 1 trials (Table 2)
studies.population: Healthy volunteers and patients; ISDB holds 3,476 subjects across 59 trials. Route split 86% SC, 8% IV, 6% SC+IV. ~1,000 subjects treated >=3 months; ~800 subject-years total exposure.
studies.n_enrolled: 3,476 total subjects in 59 trials (Supplementary Table S1 'Total' row; Table 1 'Total' row), of whom 2,618 were 2'MOE ASO-treated (Table 1 'ASO, n' Total). Abstract instead states 'over 2,600' and '2,638' - see notes.
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: Varies by analysis stratum - DO NOT SUM. Broadest ASO-treated platelet-evaluable denominator reported anywhere in the paper is 2,368 (Table 3 panel B, <75 K/uL and <50 K/uL rows) with 777 placebo. See the constituent analysis-stratum records for each stratum's own denominator.
studies.route: Systemic: subcutaneous (86% of subjects), intravenous infusion (8%), both (6%)
studies.dose_regimen: Up to 624 mg/week (abstract). Dose categories used throughout the analysis: >0-75, >75-175, >175-275, >275-375, >375-475, >475 mg/week.
studies.duration: Single weeks up to 4.6 years (longest exposure, mipomersen open-label extension)
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: Methods: 'Data collected from 52 completed, randomized, placebo-controlled, and open-label trials were analyzed.' Statistical analysis: 'Evaluated subjects were those who received at least one dose of study drug and had at least one postbaseline (BSLN) platelet count and were included in the analyses. ... BSLN was defined as the last value before the first dose.' Methods: 'In phase 1 trials, platelet counts were evaluated weekly. In phase 2 and phase 3 trials, platelet counts were assessed on average every 2 and 4 weeks, respectively.' [Crooke 2017, Materials and Methods / Statistical analysis]
studies.verification_locus: Europe PMC full text XML for PMC5467133 (fetched 2026-09-30) plus Supplementary Data PDF (Supp_Data.pdf, 10 pp., retrieved from the Europe PMC supplementaryFiles endpoint for PMC5467133). PMID 28145801; PMCID PMC5467133; doi:10.1089/nat.2016.0650 (Crooke ST et al., Nucleic Acid Ther 2017;27(3):121-129)
studies.notes: HEADLINE FOR TRIAL GRAIN: all 387 measurement rows in this cluster come from ONE publication and ONE pooled evidence unit. They are table CELLS (band x dose-group, or band x treatment-arm) of the integrated analysis, NOT separate studies. Underlying trial counts, stated by the source: the ISDB contains 59 trials for 16 distinct 2'MOE ASOs (Supplementary Data, Detailed Methods: '32 phase 1 (sixteen 2'MOE ASOs), 21 phase 2 (ten 2'MOE ASOs), and 6 phase 3 (one 2'MOE ASO) trials'; by design 43 RCT / 9 open-label / 4 drug-drug interaction / 3 other = 59, Supplementary Table S1). The MAIN analysis set is 52 trials (43 RCT + 9 OL; Supplementary Table S2 header '52 Trials'); a nested randomized placebo-controlled set is 42 trials (Supplementary Tables S5-S7); the 4 DDI crossover trials are analysed separately (Supplementary Tables S3, S4). The paper NOWHERE enumerates the 52 (or 59) constituent trials by registry id, protocol id or name. Supplementary Table S1 gives COUNTS only. Only 8 constituent trials are individually identifiable from the source's own citations and stated trial attributes, and one further trial is an inference - see the registered_trial records in this file. DEFECT IN SOURCE (denominator inconsistency for the headline 7 events): the same 7 subjects with confirmed platelet counts <100 K/uL are given three different denominators - 2,249 in the Results ('6/2,249 or 0.3%' plus one further subject), 2,368 in the Discussion ('Among 2,368 subjects treated with 2'MOE ASOs ... only 7 (0.3%)'), and 2,638 in the Abstract ('Only 7 of 2,638 (0.3%)'). Table 1's own column sum of ASO-treated subjects is 2,618, not 2,638, so the Abstract figure is not reproducible from any table in the paper and is most likely a transposition of 2,618. Use 2,249 (Table 3 panel A, normal-baseline evaluable) as the defensible denominator for the Table 3 panel A incidences. SCOPE EXCLUSIONS stated by the source: oncology trials were excluded ('the large majority of cancer patients were treated with a 2'MOE ASO in combination with cytotoxic agents and no trials were placebo controlled'); ATL1102 (Limmroth 2014, phase 2a relapsing-remitting MS) was explicitly EXCLUDED ('Because we do not have access to the primary data, data from this study are not included in our database') - the ~11% figure quoted for ATL1102 in the Discussion is secondary citation of a third-party publication and is NOT ISDB data. registry_id NOT_REGISTERED: a retrospective pooled database analysis is not a prospective clinical trial and has no trial registration; established by the Materials and Methods description of it as an analysis of already-completed trials ('All data were from completed trials or unblinded and completed interim lock data'). No registration was sought or expected for this analysis. Row TMSR108 is assigned here rather than to a narrower stratum: its locus sentence states a scope of 'all RCTs' but the curated row's own supporting detail enumerates 7 subjects of whom 2 came from an open-label extension trial, i.e. the evidence spans the RCT and the open-label strata, so no single stratum is correct.

studies.verification_locus: Crooke 2017 Supplementary Data PDF: Table S5 (baseline platelets row), Table S6 (all 80 cells), Table S7 (treatment and follow-up period rows, both panels), Table S8, Table S9, Table S12 (all 24 cells). All 80 Supplementary Table S6 values and all 24 Supplementary Table S12 values were re-extracted from the supplementary PDF and matched the curated readout_value with zero mismatches; S7, S8, S9 values were checked individually and matched.
studies.notes: QC RESULT: the 80 S6 rows are exactly its 10 bands x 8 columns and all values matched on re-extraction. The 32 S7 rows are its 2 panels x 2 periods (treatment, follow-up) x 8 columns - the 'Study period' row of S7 was correctly NOT duplicated here because it repeats S6. Again: cells of pooled tables, not studies. WHY 42 AND NOT 43: Supplementary Table S1 footnote a: 'One trial excluded from the phase 2 RCT data set (0 placebo, 2 active).' So 43 randomized placebo-controlled trials in the ISDB, 42 in this analysis set. The 24 Supplementary Table S12 rows are COAGULATION endpoints (APTT, PT), not platelet counts, and are folded into this record because they are an endpoint restriction of this same randomized placebo-controlled trial set rather than a different trial set. Their population is further restricted - Supplementary Table S12 footnote a: 'Subjects had to have received at least two doses of study drug. Incidence based on observations from the last measure collected 5 days or more after a dose and before the end of the treatment period (10 days post last dose). Data from the FXI ASO trials were excluded due to the known pharmacological effect on APTT.' Consequently NCT01713361 does not contribute to the S12 rows. Supplementary Tables S8 and S9 report a 'No. of trials' per comparison (12, 20, 27, 15, 14 for the placebo comparisons; 12, 12, 17, 10, 6 for the adjacent-dose comparisons) but never name the trials, and the source itself warns they are not the same trials across comparisons: 'The trials used in one comparison (eg, >0-75 mg/week vs. placebo) were unlikely to be the same in another comparison (eg, >75-175 mg/week vs. placebo). Therefore, comparison of the effects was indirect and must be interpreted with caution.' These counts must not be added together. Of the 42 constituent trials, 6 are individually identifiable and verified (the five mipomersen phase 3 RCTs NCT00607373, NCT00794664, NCT00706849, NCT00770146, NCT01475825, plus the ISIS 104838 phase 2 RA trial NCT00048321). studies.notes: THIS IS THE KEY ENUMERATION FINDING. The source declares a 7-study set ('four 6-month RCTs, one 1-year RCT, and two open-label extension studies'). Six of the seven ARE individually identifiable, because the Supplementary Data sentence '6 phase 3 (one 2'MOE ASO) [2-7] trials' attaches citations [2]-[7] to them, and those six supplementary references are: [2] Raal 2010 Lancet (PMID 20227758), [3] McGowan 2012 PLoS One (PMID 23152839), [4] Stein 2012 Circulation (PMID 23060426), [5] Thomas 2013 J Am Coll Cardiol (PMID 24013058), [6] Santos 2015 Eur Heart J (PMID 24366918, the open-label extension), [7] Ballantyne 2016 ATVB conference abstract (the 1-year trial). Each was resolved to a registry record via the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API AREA[ReferencePMID] search and verified for compound and phase. Records were created for all six. The SEVENTH study (the second open-label extension) is NOT identified by the source. No record was invented for it; instead a low-confidence candidate record (NCT00477594 / 301012-CS17) is included and explicitly flagged as an inference, not a source assertion. Hence constituents_identifiable = 'partial'. ARITHMETIC CORROBORATION of the four 6-month RCTs: their ClinicalTrials.gov ACTUAL enrollments are 51 + 58 + 124 + 158 = 391, against the source's 390 for the 6-month phase 3 dataset (Table 6 column totals 112 + 278 = 390; Table 7 and Supplementary Tables S10, S11 all use 129 placebo + 261 mipomersen = 390). A one-subject difference is consistent with a single non-dosed or non-evaluable subject. This sum is of DISJOINT trials and is used only to corroborate the identification, not as a pooled denominator. Likewise Supplementary Table S1's phase 3 open-label row (1 trial, 143 subjects) matches NCT00694109's 144 ACTUAL enrollment minus one. IMPORTANT ASYMMETRY: although the declared dataset spans 7 studies, Table 4 tabulates only the 5 RCTs - the open-label extension contribution appears only in the 52-trial pool (Table 3) and in the narrative '...not a single incident of a confirmed platelet drop below 50 K/uL in subjects treated with mipomersen for as long as 4.6 years' and 'Two of these subjects were from an open-label extension trial with total 2'MOE ASO exposures of 1.0 and 4.4 years'. TMSR1388 is the 4.6-year claim and is therefore assigned at this 7-study level rather than to the 5-RCT Table 4 stratum.

Crooke 2017 never names or cites the trial behind Figure 1.
